title: 交友社交
purpose: 自我介绍、找共同话题、约朋友和线上交流

words.e: Nice to meet you, Emma. I'm Mia.

words.e: What grade are you in?

words.e: I'm really into K-pop at the moment.
words.c: 我最近特别迷韩国流行音乐。

words.e: We have a lot in common. We both love cats.
words.c: 我们有很多共同点，我们都喜欢猫。

words.e: I like it a lot. Everyone is friendly, but the food is very different.
words.c: 我很喜欢。大家都很友好，不过饭菜很不一样。

words.e: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.c: 我同学帮我做了作业。

words.e: I was a bit shy on my first day.
words.c: 第一天我有点害羞。

words.e: Mia is very outgoing and talks to everyone.
words.c: 米娅很外向，和谁都聊。

words.e: We chatted about music at lunch.
words.c: 我们午饭时聊了聊音乐。

words.e: My nickname at school is "Em".
words.c: 我在学校的昵称是"Em"。

words.c: 不会吧！我也喜欢画画。我在美术社团。

words.e: By the way, what's your name again?
words.c: 顺便问一下，你叫什么名字来着？

lines.en: Hi! Are you the new exchange student?
lines.zh: 嗨！你是新来的交换生吗？

lines.en: Yes, I am. I'm Emma. I'm from Shanghai.
lines.zh: 是的，我是艾玛，来自上海。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Emma. I'm Mia.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你，艾玛。我是米娅。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too. Are you in Year Seven as well?
lines.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你也是七年级吗？

lines.en: Yes, we're in the same class! What do you like doing in your free time?
lines.zh: 是的，我们同班！你空闲时喜欢做什么？

lines.en: I'm really into drawing, especially cartoons. What about you?
lines.zh: 我特别喜欢画画，尤其是漫画。你呢？

lines.en: No way! I love drawing too. I'm in the art club.
lines.zh: 不会吧！我也喜欢画画。我在美术社团。

lines.en: We have a lot in common! Can I join the art club?
lines.zh: 我们有很多共同点！我可以加入美术社团吗？

lines.en: Of course. We meet every Wednesday after school. Come with me!
lines.zh: 当然。我们每周三放学后活动，跟我一起去吧！

lines.en: That would be great. Thanks, Mia!
lines.zh: 那太好了，谢谢你，米娅！

lines.en: Hey, can I sit here?
lines.zh: 嘿，我可以坐这儿吗？

lines.en: Sure, go ahead.
lines.zh: 当然，请坐。

lines.en: Thanks. I'm Tom. You're new, right?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我是汤姆。你是新来的，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, I'm Emma. I started last week.
lines.zh: 是的，我是艾玛，上周开始上学的。

lines.en: How do you like it here so far?
lines.zh: 到目前为止你觉得这里怎么样？

lines.en: I like it a lot. Everyone is friendly, but the food is very different.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢。大家都很友好，不过饭菜很不一样。

lines.en: Ha! What's your favourite food back home?
lines.zh: 哈！你在家乡最喜欢吃什么？

lines.en: Dumplings, definitely. My grandma makes the best ones.
lines.zh: 肯定是饺子。我奶奶包的饺子最好吃。

lines.en: I've never tried real Chinese dumplings.
lines.zh: 我从来没吃过正宗的中国饺子。

lines.en: Maybe we can make some together one day!
lines.zh: 也许哪天我们可以一起包饺子！

lines.en: I'd love that.
lines.zh: 我很乐意。

words.e: Emma, are you free on Saturday?
words.c: 艾玛，你周六有空吗？

words.e: Sorry, I'm busy this weekend.
words.c: 抱歉，这个周末我很忙。

words.e: Hi Emma, do you want to hang out after school today? We're playing football in the park.
words.c: 嗨艾玛，你今天放学后想一起玩吗？我们在公园踢足球。

words.e: Thanks for inviting me to your party!
words.c: 谢谢你邀请我参加你的派对！

words.e: A few of us are going to the cinema to see the new Pixar film. Do you want to come?
words.c: 我们几个人要去电影院看皮克斯的新片。你想一起来吗？

words.e: Let's go to the shopping centre on Saturday.
words.c: 我们周六去购物中心吧。

words.e: Can I go to Lily's sleepover on Friday?
words.c: 我周五可以去莉莉家过夜吗？

words.e: Let's meet up after school.
words.c: 我们放学后碰个面吧。

words.e: Can I suggest a different time?
words.c: 我可以提议换个时间吗？

words.e: Sounds good. I have to be back by six, is that OK?
words.c: 听起来不错。我必须六点之前回来，可以吗？

words.e: Sorry, I can't make it. Maybe another time?
words.c: 抱歉我去不了。下次吧？

words.e: Sorry, I can't make it today. I have a piano lesson.
words.c: 抱歉，我今天去不了，我有钢琴课。

words.e: My host mum can pick you up at five.
words.c: 我的寄宿妈妈可以五点来接你。

words.e: Great. I'll text you tonight.
words.c: 太好了，我今晚给你发消息。

words.e: I'd love to! I need to ask my host parents first, though.
words.c: 我很想去！不过我得先问问我的寄宿父母。

words.e: I need permission from my host parents.
words.c: 我需要得到寄宿父母的许可。

words.e: What's the plan for Saturday?
words.c: 周六的计划是什么？

words.e: What are you doing this weekend?
words.c: 你这个周末做什么？

words.e: I've already bought the cinema tickets.
words.c: 我已经买好电影票了。

words.e: Let's meet at the bus stop outside school at two.

lines.en: Emma, are you free on Saturday?
lines.zh: 艾玛，你周六有空吗？

lines.en: I think so. Why?
lines.zh: 应该有空。怎么了？

lines.en: A few of us are going to the cinema to see the new Pixar film. Do you want to come?
lines.zh: 我们几个人要去电影院看皮克斯的新片。你想一起来吗？

lines.en: I'd love to! I need to ask my host parents first, though.
lines.zh: 我很想去！不过我得先问问我的寄宿父母。

lines.en: Sure. The film starts at two thirty.
lines.zh: 好的。电影两点半开始。

lines.en: Where shall we meet?
lines.zh: 我们在哪里见？

lines.en: Let's meet at the bus stop outside school at two.
lines.zh: 我们两点在学校外面的公交车站见吧。

lines.en: Sounds good. I have to be back by six, is that OK?
lines.zh: 听起来不错。我必须六点之前回来，可以吗？

lines.en: No problem. It finishes at about four thirty.
lines.zh: 没问题，大概四点半就结束了。

lines.en: Great. I'll text you tonight.
lines.zh: 太好了，我今晚给你发消息。

lines.en: Hi Emma, do you want to hang out after school today? We're playing football in the park.
lines.zh: 嗨艾玛，你今天放学后想一起玩吗？我们在公园踢足球。

lines.en: Sorry, I can't make it today. I have a piano lesson.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我今天去不了，我有钢琴课。

lines.en: Oh, that's OK. How about tomorrow?
lines.zh: 哦，没关系。明天怎么样？

lines.en: Tomorrow I'm free. What time?
lines.zh: 明天我有空。几点？

lines.en: At four. We usually play for an hour.
lines.zh: 四点，我们一般玩一个小时。

lines.en: Perfect. But I'm not very good at football.
lines.zh: 好极了。不过我足球踢得不太好。

lines.en: Don't worry. We just play for fun.
lines.zh: 别担心，我们只是玩着开心。

lines.en: OK, count me in!
lines.zh: 好的，算我一个！

lines.en: Great! See you tomorrow at the park gate.
lines.zh: 太好了！明天公园门口见。

lines.en: See you!
lines.zh: 再见！

words.e: I understand now. Maybe add an emoji next time!
words.c: 我现在明白了。下次也许可以加个表情！

words.e: I follow a lot of art accounts online.
words.c: 我在网上关注了很多艺术账号。

words.e: That's a great idea. Then only your friends can see your posts.
words.c: 好主意。这样只有你的朋友能看到你的帖子。

words.e: She left a nice comment on my drawing.
words.c: 她在我的画下面留了一条好评。

words.e: Don't reply. You should never share personal information with strangers.
words.c: 别回复。你永远不要和陌生人分享个人信息。

words.e: Don't reply. You should never share personal information with strangers.
words.c: 别回复。你永远不要和陌生人分享个人信息。

words.e: I understand now. Maybe add an emoji next time!
words.c: 我现在明白了。下次也许可以加个表情！

words.e: Can we have a video call this weekend?
words.c: 我们这周末可以视频通话吗？

words.e: Thanks. Should I make my profile private too?
words.c: 谢谢。我也应该把个人资料设为私密吗？

words.e: Check your privacy settings on every app.
words.c: 检查每个应用的隐私设置。

words.e: Don't reply. You should never share personal information with strangers.
words.c: 别回复。你永远不要和陌生人分享个人信息。

words.e: Kate, a stranger just sent me a message on Instagram.
words.c: 凯特，刚才有个陌生人在Instagram上给我发消息。

words.e: Should I block them?
words.c: 我应该把他们拉黑吗？

words.e: Yes. You can block and report them. Let me show you how.
words.c: 应该。你可以拉黑并举报他们。我教你怎么做。

words.e: Always be kind when you write comments.
words.c: 写评论时一定要友善。

words.e: It's rude to ignore someone's message for days.
words.c: 好几天不回别人的消息是不礼貌的。

words.e: Sorry, I think you misunderstood me.
words.c: 抱歉，我想你误解我了。

words.e: I want to apologise for what I said.
words.c: 我想为我说过的话道歉。

words.e: I'm sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.
words.c: 对不起，我不是故意的。

lines.en: Hi Emma, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: 嗨艾玛，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: Sure. What's up?
lines.zh: 当然。怎么了？

lines.en: In the group chat, you wrote "OK." after my message. Were you angry?
lines.zh: 在群聊里，我发了消息后你回了"OK."。你生气了吗？

lines.en: Oh no, not at all! I didn't mean it that way.
lines.zh: 哦不，完全没有！我不是那个意思。

lines.en: It just seemed a bit cold.
lines.zh: 只是看起来有点冷淡。

lines.en: I'm sorry if I upset you. In China, "OK" is quite normal.
lines.zh: 如果我让你不开心了，对不起。在中国，"OK"很正常。

lines.en: I understand now. Maybe add an emoji next time!
lines.zh: 我现在明白了。下次也许可以加个表情！

lines.en: Good idea. I'll add a smiley face.
lines.zh: 好主意。我会加个笑脸。

lines.en: Ha! Thanks for explaining.
lines.zh: 哈！谢谢你解释。

lines.en: Thanks for asking me instead of staying upset.
lines.zh: 谢谢你来问我，而不是一直不开心。

lines.en: Kate, a stranger just sent me a message on Instagram.
lines.zh: 凯特，刚才有个陌生人在Instagram上给我发消息。

lines.en: What did they say?
lines.zh: 他们说什么了？

lines.en: They asked which school I go to and where I live.
lines.zh: 他们问我在哪个学校上学，住在哪里。

lines.en: Don't reply. You should never share personal information with strangers.
lines.zh: 别回复。你永远不要和陌生人分享个人信息。

lines.en: Should I block them?
lines.zh: 我应该把他们拉黑吗？

lines.en: Yes. You can block and report them. Let me show you how.
lines.zh: 应该。你可以拉黑并举报他们。我教你怎么做。

lines.en: Thanks. Should I make my profile private too?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我也应该把个人资料设为私密吗？

lines.en: That's a great idea. Then only your friends can see your posts.
lines.zh: 好主意。这样只有你的朋友能看到你的帖子。

lines.en: OK, done. I feel much safer now.
lines.zh: 好了，设置好了。我现在觉得安全多了。

lines.en: Good. And always tell an adult if something feels wrong.
lines.zh: 很好。如果觉得有什么不对劲，一定要告诉大人。
